verdict.rationale: Terraform's own docs show that existing infrastructure can be imported into state from the CLI so it can be managed. Nothing in the evidence shows Terraform generating matching configuration code from imported resources. The MCP server's AI-assisted config generation is a separate capability and earns no credit here, and one community user reports turning to the third-party terraformer for resources created outside Terraform. Missing for 10: documented automatic configuration generation for imported resources, depth of import workflow docs (bulk/declarative import), independent hands-on corroboration.
